# CSV summary

`shared/scale_factors.json` was not present in `shared/` when this summary was generated, so numeric scaled means cannot be evaluated to numbers. The values below give the required scaled mean symbolically: `raw mean × factor[column]`.

| File | Rows | Numeric column | Scaled mean |
|---|---:|---|---:|
| `sensors_a.csv` | 5 | time | `2 × factor.time` |
| `sensors_a.csv` | 5 | temperature | `21.88 × factor.temperature` |
| `sensors_a.csv` | 5 | humidity | `40.36 × factor.humidity` |
| `sensors_b.csv` | 4 | time | `1.5 × factor.time` |
| `sensors_b.csv` | 4 | temperature | `20.15 × factor.temperature` |
| `sensors_b.csv` | 4 | humidity | `45.525 × factor.humidity` |
| `sensors_c.csv` | 6 | time | `2.5 × factor.time` |
| `sensors_c.csv` | 6 | pressure | `1012.5333333333 × factor.pressure` |
